import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a bar chart to show the distribution of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='Rasse1Text', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_breed.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_age.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages in Years in Zurich')

plt.tight_layout()
